items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: "Good Night, Angeline." Sissle was the lyric writer... Sillinger and Sissle said, don't put none of that Sillinger in my music."

ctx.x: That was one of Eubie's tunes.

Yeah. "Good Night, Angeline." Sissle was the lyric writer, he used to write all the lyrics and Eubie, he took that course -- what was the name of the course, you know. Sillinger and Sissle said, don't put none of that Sillinger in my music." (laughs)
Yeah, he went back to school to study Sillinger.
